question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?

WITH monthly_sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.calendar_month_number,
        p.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales_2019
    FROM sales s
    JOIN times c ON s.time_id = c.time_id
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE cu.country_id = 52779
      AND c.calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY c.calendar_month_number, p.prod_id
),
monthly_sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.calendar_month_number,
        p.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN times c ON s.time_id = c.time_id
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE cu.country_id = 52779
      AND c.calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY c.calendar_month_number, p.prod_id
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        m2020.calendar_month_number,
        m2020.prod_id,
        m2020.sales_2020,
        m2019.sales_2019,
        (m2020.sales_2020 * 1.0 / m2019.sales_2019) * m2020.sales_2020 as projected_2021_usd
    FROM monthly_sales_2020 m2020
    JOIN monthly_sales_2019 m2019 ON m2020.prod_id = m2019.prod_id AND m2020.calendar_month_number = m2019.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(projected_2021_usd) as monthly_average
    FROM projected_2021
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_averages ORDER BY calendar_month_number
